headline: Storms are slowing Newark; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: Newark is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting, with 78% of departures so far today leaving within 30 minutes of schedule (302 departed). Thunderstorms, heavy rain and wind gusting to 32 knots are slowing arrivals and departures there.
Newark has 21 confirmed cancellations among its 391 departures today, and Dulles has 10 among its 248.
Rain at Washington Dulles can cause minor delays, and the other hubs are running normally.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at a United hub. Other airports have thunderstorm programs: a ground stop for flights into Boston until 9:30 PM ET, ground delay programs for flights into New York JFK and New York LaGuardia until 11:59 PM ET, and ground delay programs for flights into Philadelphia and Washington Reagan.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Boston, New York JFK or New York LaGuardia, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, since flights into those airports are being held on the ground where they start.
